name: read_literals_remaining
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,re,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd(); prov=json.loads((p/'provenance-initial.json').read_text())
for k in prov:
 raw=(p/f'originals/{k}.jsonl').read_bytes(); ob=json.loads(raw)
 m=re.search(rb'"statement"\s*:\s*("(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*")',raw);assert m
 token=m.group(1); dec=ob['statement'].encode();prov[k].update(statement_token_sha256=hashlib.sha256(token).hexdigest(),statement_utf8_sha256=hashlib.sha256(dec).hexdigest(),statement_token=token.decode(),statement=ob['statement'])
 if int(k) in [360982,362884,363824,366707,368607,369624,372452,376232]: print(k,ob['statement'],'\n')
z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'provenance.json'],input=json.dumps(prov,indent=2),text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
print('DENIALS', (p/'inherited-denials.json').read_text())
